message.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye.found: The Bog-Eye fixes on hidden loot %s blocks away.
message.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye.none: The Bog-Eye sees no unopened loot nearby.
message.kingsandmonsters.ogre_merchant.a: You have been visited by the Ogre Merchant.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.tribute_bag.kin: Unopened, the Ogre King values it as six Gold Coins.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.tribute_bag.sea: Sealed tribute for the Ogre King.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.tribute_bag.ope: An emptied tribute sack, still useful for carrying goods.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogre_truce.mech: Reduces Ogre faction anger when used.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogre_truce.flav: "By tooth and gold, the bearer is granted a measure of peace
with the Ogre Tribe — so long as the King's patience holds."
Applies Slowness II, prevents jumping for 3 seconds, and applies Bleeding.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.fresh_meat: Freshly prepared. Restores extra hunger and saturation.
Raw meat from kills becomes Fresh, restoring extra hunger and saturation even after cooking or crafting.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.boar_calling_ho: Recalls the nearest loaded tamed Mudsnout Boar you own.
Use a bowl on the placed platter to serve
message.kingsandmonsters.boar_horn.none: No tamed Mudsnout Boar answers the call.
message.kingsandmonsters.boar_horn.ridde: Your Mudsnout cannot answer while carrying a rider.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bogsteel_chestp: A small chance to turn a physical attack aside entirely, taking no damage.
Grants Strength I and Resistance I while worn.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.timber.title: Timber
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.timber.effect: Chopping a log fells every log connected to it.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.timber.sneak: Crouch to chop a single log
enchantment.kingsandmonsters.timber.desc: Chopping a log fells every log connected to it. Crouch to chop a single log. Only the Ogre King bestows it, on a Bog Iron Axe.
message.kingsandmonsters.king_need: The tribe is short of %s today. The King pays a coin extra for it.
enchantment.kingsandmonsters.barbed.desc: The spear applies Bleeding at level I and Greater Bleeding at level II, instead of Lesser Bleeding. Compatible with Heavy Throw; only one damage enchantment at a time.
enchantment.kingsandmonsters.heavy_throw: Thrown spears deal increased damage and knockback, but travel more slowly. Cannot be combined with Barbed.
enchantment.kingsandmonsters.tyrant.desc: Deals increasing bonus damage for each nearby hostile creature. Cannot be combined with other damage enchantments.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogre_kings_club: Deals 15 damage to enemies within 4.5 blocks.
Launches struck enemies into the air.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogre_kings_crow: Press %s to call a warband of ogres to fight for you.
Each call brings the next of four warbands, from the rank and file to the spellguard.
The warband leaves after a while, and the crown must rest before it can call another.
Damaging hits pull vulnerable enemies toward you.
Pulled enemies receive Slowness for 1.5 seconds.
Sweeping Edge can pull multiple enemies at once.
Bosses and fully knockback-resistant targets cannot be pulled.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.ogreblood_totem: Must be held when fatal damage is taken.
Grants Resistance II, Strength I, and Regeneration II.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye_charm.u: Reveals the nearest unopened loot container.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye_charm.r: Searches 24 blocks horizontally and 12 blocks vertically.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bog_eye_charm.c: 5 second cooldown after a find, 2 seconds after a miss.
Taking at least 2 damage activates Unyielding for 10 seconds.
• Releases a 4-block shockwave that knocks enemies back.
Hits poison the target for 4 seconds.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bogfang_blade.r: Every hit infects a living target with Bogrot for 45 seconds.
Three critical hits on a rotting target burst the Bogrot, dealing all its remaining damage at once.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.boghide_armor.g: In water: +35% swim speed and double the breath.
• Sprint-jump to leap like a toad. Cooldown: 10s
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.boghide_armor.t: • Landings slow and expose enemies for 4s; grants Speed I for 3s
• 10% less damage in water, mud, and swamps
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.blackhide_armor: • Sprint for 3s to build momentum, gaining up to +25% movement speed. At full momentum, Hog Charge becomes active for up to 12s
• Ram through up to 2 enemies for 4 damage each. After the second ram, Hog Charge ends and you become Winded for 3s
• Attack while charging to launch your foe. Weapon attacks launch farther and deal +25% damage, then end Hog Charge and leave you Winded for 3s
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.flavor.toad_ste: A bog-toad broth thick enough to put iron in an ogre's belly.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.golden_ogre_too: A gilded token of ogre favor.
Some merchants value it more than coin.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.hunters_spear: Every hit applies Lesser Bleeding; Barbed makes it stronger.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.hunters_spear.b: Hits apply Lesser Bleeding; Barbed raises it to Bleeding, then Greater Bleeding
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.hunters_spear.c: Thrown hits have a %s%% chance to apply Crippled
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.bar: Hits have a %s chance to cause Bleeding for %s. Bleeding deals %s damage per level every %s and cannot be refreshed while active.
Hits apply Bleeding instead of Lesser Bleeding.
Hits apply Greater Bleeding, the strongest a spear can apply.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.hea: Each level gives thrown spears +%s damage and +%s knockback, but reduces their speed by %s.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.tyr: Hostile creatures within %s blocks increase your attack damage. At full strength, levels I, II and III grant up to +1.6, +2.75 and +3.75 damage.
Higher levels gain more damage from each nearby enemy and can count more enemies.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.dazed: Movement speed is reduced by %s and attack speed by %s.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.crippled: Movement speed is reduced by %s and sprinting is disabled. This effect cannot be refreshed while active.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogfume_: Ogres deal %s more damage and take %s less damage.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.bleeding: Deals %s damage every %s for %s. Also drains hunger, creates blood particles and reduces healing received by %4$s.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.lesser_b: Deals %s damage every %s for %s. Also drains a little hunger and occasionally creates blood particles.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.effect.greater_: Deals %s damage every %s for %s. Also drains hunger quickly, creates frequent blood particles and reduces healing received by %4$s.
Hunter's Spear only. Combines with Heavy Throw and other non-damage enchantments, but only one damage enchantment can be on the spear at once.
jei.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.heavy_t: Hunter's Spear and Tridents. Combines with Barbed, but not with vanilla damage enchantments, Riptide or Tyrant.
Swords, axes, maces and the ogre relics, but not tridents or spears. Cannot combine with vanilla damage enchantments or Heavy Throw.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.dazed.source: Applied by the heavy attacks of Ogre Brutes and the Ogre King.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.dazed.descri: Movement speed is reduced by 20% and attack speed by 15%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.crippled.sou: Applied by Bog Toad, Ogre Grunt, Ogre Brute and Ogre Trapper bites, and by the Hunter's Spear's innate Crippled proc.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.crippled.des: Movement speed is reduced by 15% and sprinting is disabled. This effect cannot be refreshed while active.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogfume_rage: Applied to Ogre Grunts standing inside an Ogre Mage's poison fog and refreshed while they remain empowered.
Ogres deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bleeding.sou: Applied by Hunter's Spears enchanted with Barbed I and by the Trapper's Skinning Knife. A fresh hit refreshes it, and Lesser Bleeding never replaces it.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bleeding.des: Deals 1 damage every 2 seconds for 16 seconds. Also drains hunger, creates blood particles and reduces healing received by 25%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.lesser_bleed: Applied by every damaging hit from a Hunter's Spear, in melee or thrown. Enchant the spear with Barbed to make it stronger.
Deals 0.5 damage every 2 seconds for 16 seconds. Also drains a little hunger and occasionally creates blood particles.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.greater_blee: Applied by Hunter's Spears enchanted with Barbed II. It replaces any lighter bleeding and cannot be downgraded.
Deals 1.2 damage every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. Also drains hunger quickly, creates frequent blood particles and reduces healing received by 50%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogrot.descr: Deals 2 damage every 5 seconds, or every 4 seconds when caused by a creature's bite. Players take half damage. Movement and attack speed are reduced by 10%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogrot.sourc: Spread by Bog Toad and Plague Ogre bites, the Bogfang Blade and Bogrot potions. A full Boghide set keeps it off.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogstride.de: You swim 35% faster and can remain underwater twice as long.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.bogstride.so: Granted while wearing Boghide Boots in water.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.charge.descr: With a full Blackhide set, sprint for 3 seconds to activate Hog Charge. You can ram through 2 enemies, or attack to launch one. Weapon attacks launch farther and deal 25% more damage. Spending the charge leaves you Winded for 3 seconds.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.charge.sourc: Activated after sprinting for 3 seconds while wearing the full Blackhide armor set.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.ogres_bane.s: Gained for 5 minutes by eating Toad Stew.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.unyielding.d: Grants +4 armor, +2 armor toughness, +30% knockback resistance and +3 attack damage.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.unyielding.s: Triggered for 10 seconds when a full Bog Iron armor set takes a hit of 2 or more damage, releasing a shockwave. 30-second cooldown.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.warcalled.so: Granted by the Warcaller Bell while 3 or more hostile creatures are within 16 blocks, and for 2 seconds after.
jei.kingsandmonsters.effect.poison_resis: Prevents new Poison effects while active.
Gained for 2 minutes by eating Ironbelly Stew.
jei.kingsandmonsters.bogfume_rage.descri: Ogres empowered by poison fog deal 20% more damage and take 15% less damage.
jei.kingsandmonsters.hunters_spear.descr: A throwable hunting weapon. Every melee or thrown hit applies Lesser Bleeding. Barbed upgrades it to Bleeding and Greater Bleeding, and Heavy Throw trades projectile speed for damage and knockback.
jei.kingsandmonsters.kings_cleaver.descr: The Iron Maw, an ancient two-handed ogre relic. Maw's Feast restores 2 hearts after a kill, with a 3-second cooldown. Maw's Desperation grants Strength I and Speed I while at or below half health. Tyrant increases its damage when hostile creatures surround its wielder.
jei.kingsandmonsters.ogre_kings_crown.de: The Ogre King's crown. Worn, it lets you call a warband of ogres to fight for you for a short while, a different one each time, in a cycle of four. It must rest between calls.
jei.kingsandmonsters.ogre_kings_club.des: A royal ogre weapon with 12 attack damage, 0.9 attack speed, and 1600 durability. Right-click performs Royal Ground Slam, dealing 15 damage in a 4.5-block area and launching targets upward. 15-second cooldown.
jei.kingsandmonsters.ogre_tooth_necklace: Necklace slot. Grants +1 attack damage and increases the knockback of your attacks by 10%.
jei.kingsandmonsters.brute_heart.descrip: Charm slot. Grants +2 maximum hearts and 20% knockback resistance.
jei.kingsandmonsters.bog_iron_band.descr: Ring slot. Grants +2 armor, and Poison and Bogrot deal 20% less damage to the wearer.
jei.kingsandmonsters.bogfume_charm.descr: Charm slot. Melee attackers have a 30% chance to receive Poison II for 5 seconds. All Poison applied by the wearer, including potions, deals 20% more damage.
jei.kingsandmonsters.buckler.description: Hands slot. Has a 25% chance to completely block incoming arrows and increases the damage of player-fired arrows by 10%. Does not increase thrown spear damage.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.loose_chang: Find a Gold Coin, stamped with the Ogre King's mark
advancement.kingsandmonsters.first_tribu: Hand a Gold Coin to a Merchant or an Ogre captain
advancement.kingsandmonsters.toll_paid.d: Show an ogre a coin and walk past it unharmed
advancement.kingsandmonsters.parley.desc: Buy an Ogre Truce to ease the tribe's anger
advancement.kingsandmonsters.friend_of_t: Earn enough favor that the Ogre Tribe is appeased
advancement.kingsandmonsters.audience.de: Wake the Ogre King and hear what he has to say
advancement.kingsandmonsters.royal_patro: Buy something from the Ogre King's own hands
advancement.kingsandmonsters.biting_the_: Challenge the Ogre King after he has heard you out
advancement.kingsandmonsters.sticky_fing: Rob a tribute chest and watch the tribe turn on you
advancement.kingsandmonsters.mast_year.d: Pick up an acorn, a Mudsnout Boar's favourite meal
advancement.kingsandmonsters.swine_frien: Win a Mudsnout Boar's trust and tame it
advancement.kingsandmonsters.hog_wild.de: Saddle a tamed boar and ride it
advancement.kingsandmonsters.ramming_spe: Smash into an enemy while charging on a boar
advancement.kingsandmonsters.unhorsed.de: Defeat an Ogre riding a Mudsnout Boar
advancement.kingsandmonsters.root.title: Kings & Monsters
advancement.kingsandmonsters.root.descri: Challenge the Ogre Tribe and seize its crown
advancement.kingsandmonsters.usurped.des: Defeat the Ogre King and claim the throne
Use a bowl to take a serving.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bone_club.pierc: Fully charged hits ignore 20% of armor.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.bone_club.daze: A fully charged falling critical applies Dazed (6s). 10-second cooldown.
enchantment.kingsandmonsters.bogburst.de: Rupturing Bogrot spreads it to nearby enemies.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.enchantment.bog: On Bogrot rupture: spread Bogrot I (15s) within 5 blocks.
On Bogrot rupture: spread Bogrot I (25s) within 7 blocks.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.swamps_cham: Defeat the Ogre King while empowered by Ogre's Bane.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.the_swamp_h: Rupture Bogrot on an Ogre with the Bogfang Blade.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.chain_react: Spread Bogrot to 3 Ogres with a single Bogburst.
Increases the Candle Helmet's light level by 1 per level.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.candle_helmet.l: While lit and worn, illuminates the area.
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.candle_helmet.u: Unlit - place it down and light the wick with flint and steel.
screen.kingsandmonsters.king_dialogue.tr: The King will only trade with someone the tribe thinks highly of (%s favor).
tooltip.kingsandmonsters.gold_coin.flavo: A heavy coin bearing a crown no human mint would strike.
Ogre eyes linger on it with an unsettling recognition.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.ogre_toll.1: Ooh, shiny King coin. Okay. You go. Quick quick.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.ogre_toll.2: Coin is coin. Me no smash you. For now.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.ogre_toll.3: Me watch your hands, tiny one. You can go walk.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.ogre_toll.4: You pay, me nice. Not nice long time. Hurry.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.ogre_toll.5: Walk soft. Me club stay down. Me promise. Maybe.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_trials_si: The King watches the trials in silence.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_challenge: Captains! Come here! Little one want fight King! Smash him good!
screen.kingsandmonsters.king_dialogue.du: A fair fight, no captains. He yields instead of dying, and the bog iron is opened to all.
The King will only duel someone the tribe thinks highly of (%s favor).
The King is catching his breath. He will fight you fairly again in about %s minute(s).
screen.kingsandmonsters.king_dialogue.li: Ah. Small one who made King sit down hard. What you want now? No more smashing. King back hurts.
You beat King, you walk proud in my hall. Other ogres whisper your name. King pretend no hear.
King remember the fight. King not angry. Maybe little angry. Sit, talk, no smash.
Hrm. You fight good, small one. King want to fight again, when King can stand straight.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_yield.1: Hrrm. You hit hard, small one. King stand down. Throne still mine... for now.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_yield.2: Enough! King yield. You fight fair, you fight good. Tribe will remember.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_yield.3: Ha! Small one make King bleed. Okay, okay. You win. Bog iron is yours. Do not tell the captains.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_yield.4: Ahh... King need sit. You win this one. Come back when you want to be hit again.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.king_duel: You good friend of tribe. Okay, fair fight. No guards, no tricks. You come take throne, small one. King smash you.
Win a fair duel with the Ogre King and keep the tribe's favor
quest.kingsandmonsters.acorns.name: Acorns for the Herd
quest.kingsandmonsters.cull_plague.name: Plague Ogres
quest.kingsandmonsters.boar_ride.name: Boar Rider
quest.kingsandmonsters.feast.name: Meat for the King
quest.kingsandmonsters.great_cull.name: Plague Ogres
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.acorns.o: Pigs is hungry. Trees no give food. You bring six acorn. Tribe remember you.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.cull_pla: Sick ogres walk on our land. Me no hit own brothers. You hit them. Three. Go.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.boar_rid: Anyone can give pig food. You come here riding pig that is your friend. Then me trust you.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.feast.of: King belly is empty. Hall is hungry. Bring sixteen meat. Pig meat, cow meat, any meat. King eat good.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.great_cu: Rot come from bog and make ogres sick in head. You smash eight of them. King say your name in hall.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.cull_pla: Good. Go smash three sick ones.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.boar_rid: Okay. Come back with pig under your butt.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.feast.ac: Good! Sixteen meat! No rotten meat!
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.great_cu: Good. Eight sick ones. Make them dead.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.tusks.of: Me need tusk from big pig. Three tusk. Take from pig that is mean, no take from baby pig.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.of: Raw meat is for baby. Me want cooked pig leg. Six. Cook it good, no burn.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.ac: Okay. Six cooked pig leg. No burn!
quest.kingsandmonsters.toad_hunt.name: Thin the Toads
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.toad_hun: Slimy toad make ogre sick. You kill ten toad. Them live in swamp. Go.
Good. Ten toad. Smash them flat.
quest.kingsandmonsters.pillagers.name: Break the Patrols
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.pillager: Gray crossbow men roam plains near camp. Kill fifteen and break patrol.
Fifteen Pillagers. Bring no bad omen home.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.hides.of: King need black leather for new cloak. Bring eight. No holes in it.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.hides.ac: Good. Eight leather. King wait here.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast_fe: Big feast tonight! Bring twelve cooked pig leg. Tribe eat, tribe happy, you famous.
Good! Twelve cooked leg! No burn or me burn you!
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.toad_pur: Toads is everywhere in swamp. Too many! Kill ten toad. King say your name.
Good. Ten toad. Make swamp quiet.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.iron.off: Tribe need iron to make strong things. Bring twelve iron bar. Me make good gear.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.gold.off: Shiny gold! Me like. Bring six gold bar. Tribute for captain, you smart.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.logs.off: Hut is broke. Need wood. Bring thirty-two log. Any tree, me no care.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.clear.of: Bad things come at night and bite tribe pigs. You kill ten of them. Not ogre! Bad thing.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.clear.ac: Good. Ten bad thing. Go smash.
quest.kingsandmonsters.raid.name: Break the Raid
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.raid.off: Gray raiders come in packs and burn little villages. Break whole raid. Leave none standing. King pay big.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.raid.acc: Good. Break raid. Come back when villagers cheer.
quest.kingsandmonsters.ravagers.name: Bigger Beast, Bigger Glory
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ravagers: Raiders bring horn beasts that think they bigger than Mudsnout. Kill two. Prove ogre beasts best.
Two horn beasts. Hit hard. Do not get flattened.
quest.kingsandmonsters.wither.name: Three Heads, One Trophy
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.wither.o: Black three-head thing thinks it scarier than King. Wake it. Kill it. Come back alive and King make you rich.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.wither.a: Good! Smash all three heads. Try not die.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.great_cl: Too many bad thing around King hall! Kill twenty. King watch from throne, King proud.
Good. Twenty bad thing. Make hall quiet.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.acorns.o: Pig hungry. Me hungry. Bring six acorn. Pig eat, me punch things happy.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.tusks.of: Me need three tusk. Pig tusk. Not baby pig. Me look at tusk, feel strong.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.tusks.ac: Good. Three tusk. Pig no like. You do.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.of: Me want cooked pig leg. Six. Raw one make belly hurt. Fists no like.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.iron.off: Me need iron. Make fists harder. Bring twelve. Me punch good.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.gold.off: Gold is shiny. Me like shiny on fists. Six gold bar. Go.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.logs.off: Me punch tree but tree gone. Need log for hut. Thirty-two. Bring.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.cull_pla: Sick ogre walk around. Brain broke. Me no like hit friend. You hit three for me.
Good. Smash three. Be gentle. Not gentle.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.toad_hun: Toad slimy. Me punch toad, fist sticky. You kill ten toad. Me not do.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.clear.of: Bad things come at night. You smash ten. Smash good. Me watch.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.boar_rid: Me want see you ride pig. Pig that like you. Come here on pig. Me laugh.
Okay. Come on pig. Me laugh.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.acorns.o: Me, great wizard, need six acorn for potion of... pig feeding. Very scientific. Bring, peasant.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.acorns.a: Wise choice. Six acorn. Go, peasant.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.tusks.of: Tusk has magic in it. Me know, me read. Three tusk, from big pig. You get, me do magic.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.tusks.ac: Good. Three tusk. Me wait with genius.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.of: Six pig leg, cooked. Me spell need heat. Fire, me can do, but me too important. You cook.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.ac: Yes yes. Cooked leg. Not too burn.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.iron.off: Iron is good for... spell. Much magic. Twelve iron bar. You no understand. Just bring.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.iron.acc: Iron. Good. Me know you fetch.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.gold.off: Gold make me glow. Six gold bar. Me pay you with wisdom. Is better than gold.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.logs.off: Staff break. Hut break too. Thirty-two log. You chop, me supervise with brain.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.logs.acc: Many log. You strong, me smart. Is fair.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.cull_pla: Rot-sick ogre walk around. Me could blast them but me busy with important thinking. You kill three.
Three sick one. Me watch from here. For safety.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.toad_hun: Toad has eye I need for spell. Kill ten. Me very clever, me no do dirty work.
Ten toad. Careful, they slimy. Me know. Me read.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.clear.of: Bad creatures disturb me thinking. Kill ten of them. Quiet make magic good.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.clear.ac: Ten bad thing. Go quick, me thinking.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.boar_rid: Me want see pig that obey you. Ride one here. Me impress, or me laugh.
Ride pig. Me wait. Do not fall. It is funny, but not.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.acorns.o: Soldier! Pigs need feed. Six acorn. Bring them. No excuse.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.tusks.of: Three tusk, big boar only. Bring by yourself. Tribe need armor.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.of: Six cooked pig leg. For troops. No raw. Raw make soldier sick.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.roast.ac: Six cooked leg. Move out, soldier.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.iron.off: Twelve iron bar. Tribe need weapon. Move move move.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.gold.off: Six gold bar. Captain pay troop with gold. Do not argue.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.logs.off: Thirty-two log. Camp wall broken. Fix now. Go.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.logs.acc: Thirty-two log. Hurry, wall not fix itself.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.cull_pla: Plague-sick ogres on our land. Three. Kill them quick. Show them mercy.
Three plague ogre. Be careful, soldier.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.toad_hun: Ten toad from swamp. They get in camp. Clear them, soldier.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.clear.of: Ten monster. They come for camp each night. Kill them. That is order.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.boar_rid: Ride tamed pig to me. Show me you can control beast. Captain watch.
Finish a quest for the Ogre Tribe
advancement.kingsandmonsters.royal_erran: Finish a quest set by the Ogre King himself
quest.kingsandmonsters.zombies.name: Thin the Dead
Dead things crowd tribe land. Smash twenty-five zombies. Captain pay good coin.
Twenty-five zombies. Make dead things dead again.
quest.kingsandmonsters.spiders.name: Clear the Nests
Too many legs in camp at night. Kill twenty spiders and burn no huts.
quest.kingsandmonsters.creepers.name: Powder Problem
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.creepers: Green boom things ruin walls. Kill ten before they make holes.
Ten boom things. Do not bring them here.
quest.kingsandmonsters.endermen.name: Tall Shadows
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.endermen: Tall black things steal blocks from camp. Kill ten. Do not stare unless ready.
quest.kingsandmonsters.skeletons.name: Break the Bones
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.skeleton: Bone archers shoot tribe from dark. Break twenty skeletons.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.captain_: Troops hungry. Bring ten cooked meat. Any good meat, no rotten flesh.
Ten cooked meat. Feed soldiers well.
quest.kingsandmonsters.captain_gold.name: Captain's Gold
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.captain_: Ogres like gold. Captain need eight gold bars for troop pay.
Eight gold bars. Keep hands out of purse.
quest.kingsandmonsters.vindicators.name: Break the Axes
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.vindicat: Gray axe men think they strong. Kill fifteen and show them Ogre King stronger.
Fifteen axe men. Break every axe.
quest.kingsandmonsters.witches.name: Empty the Huts
Swamp witches brew poison near King land. Kill five. King no drink their soup.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.piglin_b: Nether pigs hide gold behind black walls. Kill ten big brutes. Show them who is stronger.
Ten Piglin Brutes. Take gold if you find it.
quest.kingsandmonsters.warden.name: Silence the Deep
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.warden.o: Blind beast under stone thinks nothing can kill it. Kill Warden and come back alive. King pay like king.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.warden.a: One Warden. Five teeth and nine coins if you live.
quest.kingsandmonsters.ghast_tears.name: Tears of the Nether
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ghast_te: Floating crying beast scream over fire land. Kill Ghast. Bring King two tears as proof. King pay big.
Two Ghast tears. Do not fall in lava. Bring tears, not excuses.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.elder_gu: Big spiky fish live in stone house under the sea. One big eye. Me no swim that deep. You kill it. King pay with teeth.
Good. One big fish. Bring air. Lots of air.
quest.kingsandmonsters.evokers.name: Break the Fang Callers
Mad old men in big houses call teeth out of the ground. King no like others steal his trick. Kill five of them.
Five fang men. Watch the floor!
quest.kingsandmonsters.illusioners.name: Unmask the Tricksters
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.illusion: Blue-coat men make many of them and hide. Three of these. Hit the real one. King pay for brave.
Three trick men. Hit the real one.
quest.kingsandmonsters.plague_purge.name: Purge the Rot
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.plague_p: Rot took ogres from tribe. Kill fifteen sick ones before rot spreads. King remember mercy.
Fifteen Plague Ogres. End their sickness.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.king_toa: Bog toads spread sickness through King swamp. Kill ten. King pay coin.
Ten Bog Toads. Make swamp quiet.
quest.kingsandmonsters.king_feast.name: The King's Feast
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.king_fea: King hall hungry. Bring twenty cooked meat. Good meat for big feast.
Twenty cooked meat. King save biggest piece.
quest.kingsandmonsters.king_gold.name: Gold for the Throne
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.king_gol: King throne need more shine. Bring sixteen gold bars. King pay in stamped coin.
Sixteen gold bars. Make throne shine bright.
Dead things no stay down. Me punch one, hand go through. You smash twenty-five. Use sharp thing.
Twenty-five dead things. Smash heads good.
Twenty-five corpses walk without permission. Clearly bad magic. You remove them while me study important magic.
Twenty-five zombies. Try not become twenty-sixth.
Twenty-five zombies near camp. Break the dead line and report back, soldier.
Spider crawl on sleeping mat. Me hate little legs. Twenty spiders go splat. You do it.
Spider silk useful for robes. Spider bite not useful. Kill twenty and leave webs for smarter ogre.
Twenty spiders. Do not tangle yourself, peasant.
Spider nests threaten the camp stores. Clear twenty spiders before nightfall.
Twenty spiders. Burn no supplies. Dismissed.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.creepers: Green thing sneak, hiss, blow up punching post. Me want ten gone before me punch and explode too.
Ten boom things. Make boom far away.
Creepers contain unstable alchemy. Ten samples must stop moving before me inspect craters.
Ten creepers. Keep eyebrows if possible.
Ten creepers breached the patrol line. Kill them away from walls and livestock.
Ten creepers. No new holes in camp.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.endermen: Tall shadow take block from me hut. Me look at it, it scream. You kill ten. Me look away.
Ten tall ones. Hit legs so them stay.
Endermen bend space with no proper spellbook. Offensive. Destroy ten and prove trained magic better.
Ten Endermen. Bring back your eyes where they belong.
Ten Endermen are stealing blocks from the defenses. Engage carefully and hold your ground.
Ten Endermen. Do not break formation.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.skeleton: Bone men shoot me while me eat. Rude. Break twenty into little bone snacks.
Twenty bone men. Snap every one.
Skeletons have bones but no meat. Very inefficient creatures. Remove twenty from my sight.
Twenty skeletons. Their arrows are your problem.
Twenty skeleton archers are harassing patrols. Close the distance and break their bows.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.pillager: Gray little men point crossbow at ogre camp. Me could crush. You crush fifteen first.
Fifteen gray men. Break crossbows too.
Pillagers march around like clever army. They are not clever. Remove fifteen and demonstrate this fact.
Fifteen Pillagers. Avoid their silly banners.
Pillager patrols are probing the plains outpost. Eliminate fifteen before they mass for a raid.
Fifteen Pillagers. Break the patrol. Move.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.captain_: Me hungry. Troops hungry too, probably. Bring ten cooked meat. Me count after tasting.
Ten cooked meat. Biggest piece is captain piece.
Thinking burns much food. Bring ten cooked meat for camp and one especially tender piece for great wizard.
Ten cooked meat. No charcoal disguised as dinner.
The garrison needs ten portions of cooked meat. Properly cooked, properly counted.
Ten cooked meat. Feed the line, soldier.
message.kingsandmonsters.army.resting: The crown is still resting (%s s).
message.kingsandmonsters.army.no_room: There is no room for an army here.
message.kingsandmonsters.army.ranks: The ranks answer: a Captain, two Archers and three Grunts.
message.kingsandmonsters.army.vanguard: The vanguard answers: a Captain, a Brute, a Trapper and two Grunts.
message.kingsandmonsters.army.riders: The riders answer: two Guards, three boar riders and a Mage.
message.kingsandmonsters.army.spellguard: The spellguard answers: a Mage, a Trapper, two Grunts and two Archers.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.tribe_tab.d: Earn the Tribe's favor, or take what it keeps.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.toadskin.de: Wear a full set of Boghide armor
advancement.kingsandmonsters.swamp_forge: Wear a full set of Bog Iron armor
advancement.kingsandmonsters.thick_skinn: Wear a full set of Blackhide armor
advancement.kingsandmonsters.boars_tab.d: Befriend, ride and breed the plains' great hogs.
advancement.kingsandmonsters.swamp_tab.d: Learn what the bog gives, and what it takes.
screen.kingsandmonsters.king_dialogue.li: You good for tribe, small one! King like you. Come in hall, you talk. Me listen. Maybe.
Ah! Small one who help tribe! Sit, sit. King in good mood. Say what you want.
Hrm. You smell like friend today. King happy. Talk, small one, before King change mind.
Tribe say good things about you. King hear. Come close, no be shy. King no bite. Much.
King see you bring gift. Is little. No enough! You bring more, then King maybe listen. Maybe.
Hrm. You come to hall with small gift. King notice. King want more. Then we talk.
Small one is trying. King see. But tribe still look at you with squinty eye. Bring more.
You stand in King hall like you belong. Not yet! More gift first, then King think.
You small ones take take take from tribe! Too much! Say what you want or go out King hall, me no like you.
Why you here? Tribe no like you. King no like you. Speak quick before King get angry.
Hrrr. Small one in King hall with empty hands. Bold. Stupid. Say what you want, then go.
You make tribe angry, now you come beg? King listen one minute. Maybe less.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.intro.ki: You want work, small one? King have jobs. Three of them. Pick one, make King happy.
Hrm. Small one come for King work. Good. King got three job on table. You choose.
King hall always need helping hand, even small hand. Look, three job. Which you do?
You come, you ask. King like that. Three job for you. Pick one, then go.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.intro.ca: You want work? Me got three. Pick one. No pick all.
Hrm. Small one want job. Good. Look, three thing need doing.
Tribe always need helper. Three job here. You choose, you go.
Okay, listen. Three job. Pick one you no mess up.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.intro.br: Brute got three job. Brute no do them. You pick one.
You want smash something? Good. Three thing to smash or fetch. Pick.
Hm. Small one. Me have jobs. Three. Pick fast, me bored.
Brute need help. Me no say please. Pick job.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.intro.ma: Ah, peasant seeks great wizard wisdom. And work. Three task me prepared. Choose, but choose wise.
Me, great wizard, have three important job. You lucky. Pick.
You come at good time. Me foresaw it. Three task, all very magic. Choose one.
Hmm, hmm. Small one want task? Me have three. Pick, and no touch shiny things.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.intro.gr: Soldier! Captain got three orders. Pick one. Quick.
Report for duty? Good. Three job on list. Choose. No dawdle.
At ease. Three task for tribe. You pick one, you do it good.
Camp need hands. Three orders. Choose one, then move.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.done.kin: Good! You do good, small one. Tribe like you more now.
King see what you did. Is good work! Tribe say your name in hall.
Hah! Small one not so small. King pleased. Tribe remember.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.done.cap: Hrm. Okay. You not so useless. Tribe like you more.
Job done. Me no think you can. Good. Tribe notice.
Okay okay. You did it. Take favor, go rest.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.done.bru: Good! Brute like you. Brute not punch you. Today.
You do it! Brute surprised. Brute happy. Tribe like you.
Good. Brute punch air happy now. Tribe like you more.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.done.mag: Excellent. Me say you smart. Me not mean it. But tribe like you more.
Yes yes, as me predicted. You useful tool. Tribe like you more.
Splendid. Me wisdom guide you well. Tribe like you more now.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.done.gru: Well done, soldier. Tribe notice. Captain notice too.
Task complete. Good work, soldier. Tribe see.
Dismissed with honor. Tribe like you more.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.active.k: You no finish yet. Why you stand here? Go get thing.
King job still waiting. Small one stand in hall, no help King. Go.
Not done! King no like waiting. Go go, come back when finish.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.active.c: Not done yet. Go do it. Me wait.
Why you here? Job no finish itself. Go.
Hrm. Still work to do. No stand around, small one.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.active.b: Not done. Why you here? Go.
Brute see no finished job. Brute see you standing. Bad. Go.
Job still there. You still here. Wrong. Move.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.active.m: Not finish? Me, great wizard, surprised. Not surprised. Go back.
Hmm. Job unfinished. Me foresaw this. Me still disappointed. Go.
You return with nothing? Me wisdom say: do job first, talk later.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.active.g: Not done. Why you standing here, soldier? Move out.
Task still open. No loitering. Move.
Soldier, order not finish. Go back to it.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ready.ki: You done? Gib here. King see what you worth.
Ah, small one return! You bring it? Gib to King. King count.
King see you coming with full hands. Good. Gib here.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ready.ca: You got it? Okay. Hand over, me check.
Ha, you did it. Gib here, small one.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ready.br: You done? Me see. Give. Me punch nothing today. Happy.
You bring it? Good. Give. Brute count with fingers. Slow.
Hm! Brute see. Give here. Quick, before pig see.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ready.ma: Ah, you return! Me predicted. Me always predict. Give it here.
Yes yes, you have it. Me know. Hand it over, peasant.
Impressive. Me expected less. Me expected correctly. Give it here.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ready.gr: Report. You done? Hand it over.
Soldier return! Hand over the goods. Quick.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.ready_do: You done it? King hear. Tribe will know your name.
King hear tale of what you did. Is good tale. Tribe will know your name.
Small one finish King job! King proud. Come, take reward.
Is done? Good. You did good.
You finish? Me hear. Okay. Come take reward.
Hrm. Job done. Not bad, small one.
You smash it? Good. Me happy. Take favor.
Brute hear it is done. Good smash. Take favor.
Done? Me no check. Me trust. Little bit. Take favor.
Ah, you return! Me predicted. Me always predict. Is done, yes? Me knew.
Is finished? Of course. Me foresaw. Take favor, peasant.
Done, yes? Me felt it in my wizard bones. Come, favor for you.
Report. Task done? Good. Tribe notice.
Task complete? Confirmed. Well done, soldier.
You back already? Good. Report accepted.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.busy.kin: You still do captain work. Finish that first, then ask King for more.
Captain give you job already. King no take you away. Finish it, then come.
One job at a time, small one. Finish captain thing, then King talk.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.busy.cap: You do King work now. Me no care about small job. Go finish.
King give you job. King first. Go, finish.
Hrm. King job heavy. Me wait. Go.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.busy.bru: You work for King. Me no touch. Go finish.
King job first. Brute job after. Go.
You busy with King thing. Brute no argue with King. Go.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.busy.mag: You do King quest. Me not important enough? ...Me is important. Finish King thing first.
King task already on you. Me understand. Me still important. Go finish.
Hmm, King borrow my helper. Me allow. Go, finish, then come back.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.busy.gru: You carry King quest. King first. Go finish. Dismissed.
King orders come before captain orders. Go.
You serve King now. Finish that, soldier.
dialogue.kingsandmonsters.quest.cooldown: No more work now. Come back when fire is small.
King have no job right now. Come back later, small one.
Hall quiet. No work. King want rest. Come later.
Nothing now. Come back later, small one.
No job right now. Go away a bit. Come back.
Me got nothing. Wait. Tribe find new trouble soon.
No more. Me punch bag now. Come later.
No job. Brute busy punching. Come back.
Nothing now. Brute need rest. Little bit.
No more work. Me need rest from being smart. Come back.
Me already gave you wisdom and task. Enough. Come back later.
All jobs done. Me must think now. Do not disturb.
No more orders now. Come back later, soldier.
Roster empty. Stand down. Return later.
No task now. Rest. Captain call when needed.
boss_checklist.summon.kingsandmonsters_o: Find the Ogre Fort, using a Fort Map from an Ogre Merchant, and wake him in his hall.
boss_checklist.desc.kingsandmonsters_ogr: Ruler of the Ogre Tribe, who fights alongside his court and the Ogre subjects around him.
boss_checklist.info.kingsandmonsters_ogr: His Crown and Club drop only if he is killed. A player the Tribe holds in the highest regard can ask for a duel instead.
